body: commit 95567e7 -- a hero attacking an enemy hero within a lane creep's aggro radius now pulls that creep's aggro onto the attacker, overriding the plain-nearest pick. Detected via defender-side last_attacked_by_owner + combat_timer_ms (damaged_this_tick isn't usable here due to call ordering, flagged honestly rather than reordering). New test confirms redirect wins over a closer bystander. Full suite + test_10_bots.sh green.
title: S170-214: minion-aggro-redirect on lane creeps
